description: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B with immutable checkpoint files and an ARM64 runtime. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Per-node peak is an estimate: GPU memory utilization times 130,663,231,488 bytes plus 8 GB for runtime/host overhead and the library's 17 GB separate-drafter allowance; reserve is informational, with the platform OS floor accounted separately. Uses NVIDIA's Spark-recommended LiLiCorr seven-token draft and Mamba cache configuration.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B vLLM single Spark
